daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo delivered remarks at a public event emphasizing national unity, calling on all elites to unite across political and cultural sectors. Separately, Prabowo warned that nuclear war dangers cannot be underestimated, and stated that divide-and-rule tactics are real, not just found in books. The president will lead the 81st Independence Day ceremony in Jakarta.

  • Coordinating Minister for Political, Legal and Security Affairs reminded officials to maintain trust and honesty in their duties.
  • The Coordinating Minister for Political, Legal and Security Affairs also called on local governments to lead efforts to counter hoaxes in the digital space.
  • Public Works Minister AHY said Gresik's settlement planning could eradicate slum areas nationwide.
  • Basic Education Minister Purbaya reaffirmed state budget support for the Sekolah Rakyat program.
  • The Presidential Palace and Trade Minister commented on high fences in shopping malls.

Foreign Policy & Defence

President Prabowo is preparing to depart for North Korea in a planned diplomatic visit. The U.S. Ambassador to Indonesia responded to the killing of an American pilot in Papua. The Merauke Regency government is awaiting a full report on the shooting of a fishing vessel in Papua New Guinea waters.

  • Indonesia and India expanded digital partnership cooperation on artificial intelligence.
  • Former Foreign Minister Retno Marsudi warned that climate change exacerbates the global water crisis.
  • The National Border Management Agency (BNPP) strengthened cross-sector synergy through its 2026 Action Plan.

Other

The National Food Agency (Bapanas) revoked permits for substandard fortified rice producers following quality control failures. The agency's oversight arm BGN found 414 problematic accounts related to SPPG (subsidized food procurement) and is investigating 5,355 SPPG kitchens suspected of violations. BGN will submit the MBG budget scheme to the Ministry of Finance.

  • Indonesia raised cocoa export benchmarks in response to supply shortages.
  • Coordinating Minister for Political, Legal and Security Affairs stated that Indonesia remains attractive to investors amid global dynamics.
  • Telkom recorded revenue, EBITDA and profit growth in the first half of 2026, while BKSL achieved 387 percent profit growth in the same period.
  • The Environment Ministry said ground operations are key to containing forest and land fires, as Indonesia remains confident Kalimantan fires can be contained.
  • Indonesia plans a water farming policy to protect groundwater resources.
